610:t_1:86.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Wherever $$サイデリアル$$ goes, there is always battle... and thus death.」

610:t_1:87.en:
$$尸刻$$
「It is $$鬼宿$$'s duty to guide lost lives to heaven... In that sense, this is a fitting place for us.」

610:t_1:88.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So it doesn't bother you that most of your clan was wiped out...」

610:t_1:89.en:
$$尸刻$$
「What about you, General $$サルディアス$$?」

610:t_1:90.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「I hear you've served $$サイデリアル$$ much longer than we have, but I've never heard about your past.」

610:t_1:91.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Unlike you two, I wasn't recruited along with an entire organization. There's not much worth telling.」

610:t_1:92.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「My homeworld was destroyed, and I joined $$サイデリアル$$. I was leading a unit to seize the $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$, and before I knew it, I'd become its Reactor's aide. Yes.」

610:t_1:93.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「So you were a candidate to become its Reactor?」

610:t_1:94.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「I was, embarrassing as that is...」

610:t_1:95.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Of course, at first, my planet had been destroyed and I'd lost my family and comrades... I hated everything in the world, just like $$バルビエル$$.」

610:t_1:96.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But... in the end, I abandoned my hatred to save my own skin... I'm in no position to laugh at Mr. $$ガドライト#pilot$$.」

610:t_1:97.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$... I hear that man has rebelled against $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_1:98.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, that's only natural, considering his circumstances.」

610:t_1:99.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Are you trying to say we're in the same position?」

610:t_1:100.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So you noticed I was fishing for a reaction...」

610:t_1:101.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well... Even if we're dissatisfied deep down, we have no choice but to make do in our current positions.」

610:t_1:102.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Of course. My battlefield is wherever Lady $$エルーナ$$ is.」

610:t_1:103.en:
$$尸刻$$
「As long as $$尸空#pilot$$ fulfills $$鬼宿$$'s mission, the entire clan can only follow him.」

610:t_1:104.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Then, now that our resolve is firm, let us defend $$ラース・バビロン$$'s defensive line to the death.」

610:t_1:105.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Let us meet the expectations of our superiors, who have stationed their three prized aides here.」

610:t_1:106.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「That was my intention from the start.」

610:t_1:107.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I will fulfill my assigned mission.」

610:t_1:108.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Each of us has our own feelings about $c too. Let us fight here with our backs to the wall.」

610:t_2:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Still, I was surprised to learn that you and the Chief were with Dr. $$トライア$$, $$トビー$$.」

610:t_2:5.en:
$$トビー$$
「The doctor saved our lives. Acting as her bodyguards is our way of repaying her.」

610:t_2:7.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「$$トビー$$ and I aren't from $$ＵＣＷ$$ or $$ＡＤＷ$$... We're like foreign objects that $$アサキム$$ dragged here by force.」

610:t_2:8.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Maybe that's why the $$新世時空震動$$ sent us and our $$バルゴラ$$s into something like a gap between dimensions.」

610:t_2:9.en:
$$トビー$$
「And the doctor was the one who rescued us.」

610:t_2:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm so glad I can see you both again like this.」

610:t_2:11.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「It seems you protected the $$グローリー・スター$$ name while we were gone.」

610:t_2:12.en:
$$トビー$$
「That's our ace. At this rate, you don't need the Chief or me to back you up anymore.」

610:t_2:14.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Every soldier has a role. Ours is protecting the $$ソーラリアン$$.」

610:t_2:15.en:
$$トビー$$
「We're leaving the front line to you, $$セツコ$$. Give $$サイデリアル$$ a taste of our $$ＧＳコンバット・アクション$$.」

610:t_2:17.en:
$$ランド$$
「Still, to think you were $$クロノ$$'s Queen, Sis.」

610:t_2:19.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You say that, but $$クロノ$$ chose that codename for me.」

610:t_2:20.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「If you'd joined $$クロノ$$ too, I'm sure you'd have received a lovely codename.」

610:t_2:22.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「You'd get something like 'Child' or 'Baby'.」

610:t_2:25.en:
$$メール$$
「You can't just call that a joke!」

610:t_2:26.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I'm sorry, $$メール$$. ...But you seem a little more grown-up than the last time I saw you.」

610:t_2:28.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Sorry, but I'm a little tired... Would you make me some coffee?」

610:t_2:30.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「She's as trusting as ever.」

610:t_2:32.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Looking at her reminds me of a past I can never return to...」

610:t_2:34.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Don't worry about me. I'm living with my past behind me too.」

610:t_2:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「So how did you end up in $$クロノ$$?」

610:t_2:36.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I knew it existed back when I was in $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

610:t_2:37.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Though its existence was completely hidden there, since $$ロゴス$$ and the $$ティターンズ$$ operated in the open.」

610:t_2:38.en:
$$ランド$$
「I'd think 《$$ジ・エーデル#keyword$$》 would happily crush such a sneaky, arrogant organization...」

610:t_2:39.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「He tacitly allowed $$クロノ$$ to exist.」

610:t_2:41.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Do you think I could understand what that man was thinking?」

610:t_2:42.en:
$$ランド$$
「You're right. Nobody could keep up with his crazy way of thinking.」

610:t_2:43.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「But this world's $$クロノ$$, formed from the organizations in $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$, protected me when the $$新世時空震動$$ brought me here.」

610:t_2:44.en:
$$ランド$$
「Was it because you're one of those singularities, Sis?」

610:t_2:45.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Exactly. ...After the $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed, I thought I'd be handed over to $$サイデリアル$$, but...」

610:t_2:46.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「The King let me escape.」

610:t_2:47.en:
$$ランド$$
「The King is $$クロノ$$'s leader, right? Then why...?」

610:t_2:48.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Looking back now, it seems the King had his own reservations about $$サイデリアル$$.」

610:t_2:49.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Though he couldn't take concrete action. He seemed to be an old man who could only watch events unfold.」

610:t_2:50.en:
$$ランド$$
「So to protect yourself too, you supported us in fighting $$サイデリアル$$...」

610:t_2:51.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「That was part of it.」

610:t_2:52.en:
$$ランド$$
「That was only part of it...?」

610:t_2:53.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I wanted to try believing too. In the light of people's hearts that I saw in the $$多元戦争$$.」

610:t_2:55.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「...What happened to $$アサキム$$?」

610:t_2:56.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$ took him down. Though that probably won't kill him.」

610:t_2:58.en:
$$ランド$$
「Could it have been you who released him from the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on Mars...?」

610:t_2:59.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ has $$スフィア・リアクター$$s too... I thought he might help keep them in check, even a little, but...」
